note: Popular SillyTavern UI extensions that are not in the official catalogue. Each was checked to have a manifest.json at its default branch root. Star counts as of 2026-10-13.

items.description: A SillyTavern extension providing a multi-tier memory and narrative context system for AI roleplay. Tracks character facts, relationship history, per-character knowledge and secrets, entity state, scene history, story arcs, and rolling summaries - extracted automatically so your AI stays coherent no matter how long the story runs.

items.description: Summaries inline in the chat

items.description: An immersive RPG enhancement extension for SillyTavern — character tracking, lore library, TTS highlighting, portrait bar, scene headers, chat bubbles, weather effects, and more.

items.name: WeatherPack

items.name: EchoText
items.description: Text characters directly, phone-style

items.name: Character Tools
items.description: SillyTavern extension for analyzing and improving character cards

items.name: ScenePulse
items.description: AI-powered scene intelligence extension for SillyTavern — tracks characters, relationships, quests, mood, and more in a real-time dashboard

items.name: Character Card Studio
items.description: SillyTavern extension to create Character Cards and Lore entires using AI

items.name: BlazeTracker
items.description: A SillyTavern extension that uses LLM analysis to track and maintain scene state across roleplay conversations. Helps AI models stay consistent with physical positions, outfits, time of day, mood, and narrative tension.

items.name: ThreadKeeper
items.description: LLM-powered memory for long roleplays, keep facts for a fraction of the cost.

items.name: Lorebook Studio
items.description: Visual 3D node-graph lorebook editor for SillyTavern — organize entries with categories, tags, and workflow tracking.

items.name: ACE Entry Track
items.description: Lightweight World Info tracker for SillyTavern — live entries, keyword matches, token budget, diff tracking.

items.name: StatefulLore
items.description: SillyTavern extension that replaces the built-in lorebook with a stateful, code-driven lore engine.

items.name: Inline Image Generation
items.description: Inline image generation for SillyTavern. Images appear right inside chat messages. No separate panel. No workflow interruption.
